definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'indexed organization: The permanent logical file structure in which each record is identified by the value of one or more keys within that record'; 2023 describes it in D.2.2.3 and 12.4.5.10 GR5 in the same terms. SR8 restricts START WITH LENGTH to such files; 2002's organizations are sequential, relative and indexed, so the refused set is the same; pb352-start-length-non-indexed refuses at --std 2002.
